components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid transparent; background:var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); color:var(--color-on-brand, #fff); font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight:600; font-size:1rem; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-brand-strong, #2f4cc4); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Quiet Button

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: One of four A–D rows; the native radio covers the row invisibly.
components.css: .ds-options { display:grid; gap:12px; font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-option { position:relative; display:block; } .ds-option input { position:absolute; opacity:0; inset:0; margin:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-option-body { display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:center; min-height:64px; padding:12px 20px; border:1px solid var(--color-hairline, #dfe3ea); border-radius:12px; background:var(--color-elevated, #fff); color:var(--color-text, #14171f); font-size:1.0625rem; line-height:1.45; transition:border-color 120ms, background-color 120ms; } .ds-key { flex:none; width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--color-text-muted, #4a5162); display:grid; place-items:center; font-weight:700; font-size:.875rem; } .ds-option:hover .ds-option-body { border-color:var(--color-line, #c5ccd8); } .ds-option input:checked + .ds-option-body { border-color:var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); background:var(--color-brand-tint, #e9eeff); } .ds-option input:checked + .ds-option-body .ds-key { background:var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); border-color:var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); color:var(--color-on-brand, #fff); } .ds-option input:focus-visible + .ds-option-body { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Slide Card
components.description: Catalog entry: a 16:9 frame with the two-digit number; unavailable entries stay, dashed and stamped.
components.css: .ds-deck { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 208px); gap:20px; font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-slide { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; padding:0; border:0; background:none; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; border-radius:8px; color:var(--color-text, #14171f); font:inherit; } .ds-slide:disabled { cursor:default; } .ds-frame { position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; width:100%; border:1.5px solid var(--color-line, #c5ccd8); border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-elevated, #fff); display:flex; align-items:flex-start; padding:12px 16px; transition:border-color 120ms, box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-num { font-size:1.75rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.02em; } .ds-corner { position:absolute; right:12px; bottom:8px; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-text-muted, #4a5162); } .ds-title { font-weight:600; } .ds-slide:not(:disabled):hover .ds-frame, .ds-slide:not(:disabled):focus-visible .ds-frame { border-color:var(--color-shell, #1d2a44); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(20 23 31 / .06), 0 4px 12px rgb(20 23 31 / .06); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-slide:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-brand, #3b5bdb); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-slide:disabled .ds-frame { background:var(--color-recessed, #eef1f5); border-style:dashed; } .ds-slide:disabled .ds-num, .ds-slide:disabled .ds-title { color:var(--color-text-muted, #4a5162); } .ds-stamp { align-self:flex-start; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-warning, #8a5a00); border:1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius:4px; padding:1px 8px; transform:rotate(-3deg); }

components.css: .ds-source { width:300px; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--color-hairline, #dfe3ea); border-radius:12px; background:var(--color-elevated, #fff); font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--color-text, #14171f); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-sframe { position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; max-width:240px; border-radius:4px; border:1.5px solid var(--color-shell, #1d2a44); background:var(--color-canvas, #f7f8fa); padding:12px 16px; margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-snum { font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1; } .ds-laser { position:absolute; right:14px; top:14px; width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--color-laser, #f59f00); } .ds-page { position:absolute; right:8px; bottom:4px; font-size:.875rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--color-shell, #1d2a44); background:var(--color-elevated, #fff); padding:0 8px; border-radius:3px; } .ds-sname { margin:0; font-weight:600; font-size:.875rem; } .ds-sid { margin:2px 0 0; font-size:.8125rem; color:var(--color-text-muted, #4a5162); word-break:break-all; }

components.css: .ds-shell { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; min-height:64px; padding:8px 32px; background:var(--color-shell, #1d2a44); color:#fff; font-family:var(--font-sans, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-weight:700; font-size:1.0625rem; } .ds-stitle { color:#b9c3d8; font-size:.875rem; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-strip { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-thumb { position:relative; width:48px; height:28px; padding:0; border-radius:4px; border:1.5px solid #55658a; background:transparent; color:#b9c3d8; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms; } .ds-thumb span { position:absolute; right:4px; bottom:1px; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; } .ds-thumb:hover { border-color:#b9c3d8; } .ds-thumb.is-answered { background:#fff; border-color:#fff; color:var(--color-shell, #1d2a44); } .ds-thumb.is-current { box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-shell, #1d2a44), 0 0 0 4px #f59f00; } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f59f00; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-timer { margin-left:auto; font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview:
CramAI looks like the room the slides were first shown in: a dark slate band across the top where the lecturer's controls live, a pale projector-screen ground below, and everything that stands for a slide drawn as a small 16:9 frame with its number in the corner. The learner is never shown an abstract card; they are shown a slide, a page, a deck. The frame is the unit of the whole system: catalog entries, quiz progress, citations, admin slot rows and draft excerpts are all the same nearly-square 16:9 outline at different sizes.

Density is calm and work-like. One question at a time, one primary action, generous 4px-based spacing, and a single blue for anything the learner chose or should press next. Status is carried by shape before colour: answered thumbnails are filled, unanswered are hollow, missing or unavailable things are dashed, and states that end something (an expired attempt, an unpublished slot) are stamped on, never removed. Light and dark themes share every role through `light-dark()` pairs in `tokens.css`; the slate shell stays dark in both.

The token vocabulary is a plain-CSS reimplementation of two references, kept as a binding product constraint: Astryx (Meta) for radius steps, the 4px spacing scale, control heights, the 2px focus outline and status hues; Kumo (Cloudflare) for the brand blue, the canvas / elevated / recessed surface roles, and the hairline-versus-line border split. Neither library is a dependency.
keyCharacteristics: Slate shell (dark in both themes) over a projector-screen canvas.
The 16:9 slide frame with a corner number is the recurring signature at every scale.
One accent: brand blue for selection and the primary action; laser amber only as a "here" marker.
State by fill shape and border style (filled, hollow, dashed, stamped) before hue.
Be Vietnam Pro throughout with tabular figures; numbers 01–14 are primary identity.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; one soft shadow, only as a hover lift.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Brand blue means "chosen" or "press this next". It is never a heading colour, a decorative fill or a status.

rules.name: The Laser Dot Rule
rules.body: Amber is a pointer, not a paint. It appears as a dot, a ring or a short run of text on the slate shell, and nowhere as a surface.

rules.name: The Hairline-or-Line Rule
rules.body: Flat surfaces get a hairline; objects you can pick or that represent a slide get a line. Never stack both on one element.

rules.name: The Numbers Lead Rule
rules.body: Slide numbers are written as two digits (01–14) and set heavier than the title beside them; the number is the identity, the title is the description.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are always tabular. A timer or score that shifts width while it changes is a bug.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow while still. The one ambient shadow is a response to hover or focus on a pickable slide; the selection and laser rings are outlines drawn with box-shadow, not depth.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: A slide is always 16:9, 4px corners, 1.5px outline, with its number in a corner. Never round a frame to the 12px container radius.

dos: **Do** draw anything that stands for a slide or a page as a 16:9 frame with 4px corners, 1.5px outline and its number in a corner.
**Do** write slide numbers as two digits (01–14) with tabular figures, heavier than the title next to them.
**Do** show state by fill and border style first (filled / hollow / dashed / stamped), then reinforce with colour and an icon or word.
**Do** keep unavailable and expired things visible and stamped with their reason.
**Do** reserve brand blue for the selected answer, the primary action, focus and links.
**Do** keep laser amber to dots, rings and short shell text that say "here".
**Do** use hairline borders for flat surfaces and line borders for pickable objects.
**Do** pull every colour, radius, space and duration from `tokens.css`, and keep the student and admin copies identical.
**Do** respect reduced motion: transitions and the laser animation drop to zero.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent hue or use blue for headings, decoration or status.
**Don't** fill panels or body text on the light canvas with laser amber.
**Don't** round slide frames to container radii or give them shadows at rest.
**Don't** remove an entry, a question or a citation to signal that it is unavailable, missing or expired.
**Don't** distinguish answered from unanswered by colour alone.
**Don't** import Astryx or Kumo packages; tokens are reimplemented in plain CSS.
